exports.name: CornerRecede
exports.description: D05 — the corner under the pointer recedes like a folded page (`div.neshel-corner`).

props.name: set
props.description: Animate to a pose (programmatic or external progress).

props.name: corners
props.description: Corners that may fold (default all four).

props.name: flap
props.description: `"clone"`: inert ID-free copy of the surface; `"plain"`: a surface-coloured triangle (default "clone").

props.name: focusCorner
props.description: Corner folded at 35 % while focus inside is `:focus-visible`; `false` disables (default "top-right").

props.name: reverse
props.description: Lift the corner toward the viewer instead of receding (default false).

props.name: size
props.description: Fold leg as a fraction of the shorter side 0.1–0.6 (default 0.35).

props.name: surface
props.description: The live content element that is clipped (default: the root's first element child).
